{"recommendation":"escalate","explanation":"The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the four quarters ended September 30, 2026 is {{fact:5b61399a-8531-42bb-a229-39ef26af3fee}}. The minimum under Section 6.1 is {{fact:77721a76-1ddd-4eb0-9539-9ed32d14186a}}, so the ratio falls short by {{fact:b37d8dd6-944b-4c18-b234-30e87bc1ee47}}. This looks like a real breach. The borrower's Q3 2026 compliance certificate reports the same ratio, {{fact:3a9a3c97-f1e6-4f16-acce-83e6cc7bcddb}}, and says the borrower is not in compliance. Only one terms version is on file, the approved original agreement. There are no unapproved amendments, no add-backs apply to this covenant, and a search for a waiver found only the agreement's own Section 9.1 clause. That clause requires any waiver to be in writing and signed by both parties. Rerunning the test under version 1 gave the same result, {{fact:cd827479-b981-4d4f-abb8-7c465667babf}}, below the minimum of {{fact:b46d3981-8152-4f52-9b6d-4958d3366057}}.
